offering_description.value: Weis Markets sells groceries, fresh foods and household goods to shoppers through its supermarkets and online ordering. It makes some of its own dairy and other store-brand foods and operates pharmacies and fuel stations at select locations.

primary_products.value: Packaged groceries; fresh and prepared foods; household and personal care goods; prescription and over-the-counter medicines; motor fuel

primary_services.value: Prescription dispensing; vaccinations; grocery pickup and delivery

customer_segment.value: B2C: Household grocery shoppers, pharmacy patients and motorists

end_markets.value: Grocery retail; retail pharmacy; motor fuel retail

revenue_model.value: product sales: Groceries, household goods, medicines and motor fuel; healthcare reimbursement: Insurer and pharmacy benefit plan payments for covered prescriptions and vaccinations

value_chain_position.value: retailer: Buys groceries, medicines and fuel from suppliers and sells them to consumers; OEM / manufacturer: Processes milk and makes ice cream for sale through its supermarkets; service provider: Fills prescriptions and administers vaccines to pharmacy patients

geography_served.value: US regional: Pennsylvania, Maryland, Delaware, New Jersey, New York, West Virginia and Virginia

specialization.value: related lines: Supermarkets, in-store pharmacies, fuel stations and store-brand food production

distribution_channels.value: own locations: Company-operated supermarkets, in-store pharmacies and fuel stations; online: Company website and app for grocery pickup and delivery

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Pharmacies require state licensure and DEA registration for controlled substances. Food operations are subject to food safety rules.
